sections.title: Form and growth
sections.text: This catalogue entry is Potentilla reptans, creeping cinquefoil. It is a low perennial, usually 10–20 cm tall, whose runners can reach about 1 m and root at their nodes.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its palmately divided leaves have five to seven toothed leaflets. Bright yellow flowers are about 1.5–2.2 cm across. The fruit is an aggregate of small achenes.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The Royal Horticultural Society labels the fruits ornamental and advises that they are not to be eaten; no edible use is given here.
